site.audience: Oil and gas operators, energy companies, and industrial asset managers seeking SaaS data management solutions

brief.title: WellStream Platform — Integrated Energy Data Management
brief.one_liner: WellStream delivers integrated SaaS solutions for energy operators to manage well data, production, and land assets—streamlining operations and enhancing decision-making.
brief.goal: Drive demo requests and educate energy industry professionals about the platform's capabilities across the well data lifecycle, security, and integration features.

pages.objective: Introduce the platform with a bold hero, showcase use cases, display the platform ecosystem diagram, and highlight company culture and renewables offerings.
Detail the platform's value propositions, key statistics, implementation speed, expandable feature sections, and client testimonials.
Communicate the platform's security foundations, compliance certifications, and infrastructure protections with tabbed content for Security and SOC Compliance.
Explain integration capabilities through ETL, APIs, and Dashboards with tabbed navigation and key benefits for each integration method.
Capture lead information through a structured demo request form and provide global support contact options.

interactions.trigger: Click on use case cards in the grid
interactions.expected: Navigate to detailed use case page or display use case details

interactions.trigger: Click industry tab labels (E&P, Midstream, Downstream, Utilities, Solar/Wind, Mining)
interactions.expected: Tab content switches to show solutions relevant to the selected industry

interactions.trigger: Click on expandable section headers (Get Speed, Get Secure, Get Mobility, Get Real-Time Reporting, Get Connected)
interactions.expected: Accordion panel expands to reveal detailed content, other panels collapse

interactions.trigger: Click Our Company or Careers tab
interactions.expected: Tab content switches between company info and careers content

interactions.trigger: Click carousel navigation dots below testimonials
interactions.expected: Testimonial cards slide to show next set of client quotes

interactions.trigger: Click Security or SOC Compliance tab
interactions.expected: Content switches between security details and SOC compliance information

interactions.trigger: Click ETL, APIs, or Dashboards tab
interactions.expected: Content panel switches to show details for the selected integration method

interactions.trigger: Fill out form fields and click Submit button
interactions.expected: Form validates required fields and submits the demo request

interactions.trigger: Click Accept or Decline on cookie consent banner
interactions.expected: Cookie banner dismisses and preference is stored
